Chapter 772: Chapter 3 Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter (Please Subscribe)

On the nine grand thrones, the nine Supreme Beings looked at Lin Yuan, their expressions unusually displaying astonishment.

He figured out the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule?

Lin Yuan figured out the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule?

With the talent Lin Yuan had shown, he had thoroughly understood the Rule of Time by the Ninth Rank.

The Xia Qin Supreme Being and other Supreme Beings did not doubt that Lin Yuan could figure out the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.

For most Eleventh-Rank Evolvers, it would take billions of years to attempt what Lin Yuan, as one of humanity’s strongest prodigies, would not consider a significant bottleneck or restraint.

...

The Supreme Beings had hoped Lin Yuan would reach the Ultimate, standing alongside them as a colossal pillar of Human Civilization.

But the nine Supreme Beings had never expected Lin Yuan to figure out the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule so quickly.

Too quickly.

So quickly that the Supreme Beings had not anticipated it at all.

When Lin Yuan had thoroughly understood the Rule of Time, Xia Qin Supreme Being had even given him a push, taking him to the ‘shore’ of the River of Time to observe its entirety.

Now, he had figured out the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule all on his own?

And how long had Lin Yuan been at the Tenth Stage? Although he had spent over ten thousand years in the Two-dimensional World,

it was a lower-dimensional world devoid of any rule fluctuations, completely unsuitable for perceiving the rules of time and space.

“You really figured out the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule?”

The Void God Supreme Being was somewhat surprised and couldn’t help but ask.

Time and space themselves are the highest pillars of rules, and Void God Supreme Being specializes in space, also boasting considerable expertise in time.

“By luck…”

With a slight movement of his thoughts, Lin Yuan invoked the fusion of the Power of Space-Time.

Compared to the explosive growth of physical soul, discerning the subtleties of rule perception, unless actively demonstrated, is hard for outsiders to precisely identify.

“It truly is the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.”

With just one look, the nine Supreme Beings confirmed that Lin Yuan had fully mastered the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.

“You…”

Xia Qin Supreme Being felt quite helpless—as he had intended to offer Lin Yuan some insights into figuring out the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, but now, it seemed entirely unnecessary.

“Since you’ve already figured out the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, there really is no need to go and view the entirety of the River of Time.”

Feather Butterfly Supreme Being slowly said.

Viewing the entire River of Time only aids in grasping the Rule of Time and figuring out the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.

As for more? The effects are not as great as one might imagine. After figuring out the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, further cultivation relies on oneself, and external influences are very limited.

“With your current Life Level, figuring out the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule is indeed rare, but you must not be complacent or overconfident. If you want to reach the peak, figuring out the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule is only the beginning. You need to continuously grasp it, elevating it to the Second Realm, Third Realm, and even Fifth Realm.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being wasn’t sure what more to say, so he offered standard advice.

To challenge the Ultimate, the prerequisite is to comprehend the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule up to the Fifth Realm. The time and effort it takes to go from the First Realm to the Fifth Realm are hard to estimate.

Xia Qin Supreme Being’s words caused a subtle shift in the thoughts of the other eight Supreme Beings.

He reached the Tenth Stage and figured out the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, and yet he should not be overconfident? What did that make them? Including Xia Qin Supreme Being, none of the nine Supreme Beings had figured out the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule at the Tenth Stage.

“Understood.”

Lin Yuan nodded in agreement.

Xia Qin Supreme Being was right; figuring out the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule was just the beginning. The real challenges were progressing from the Second to the Fifth Realm.

Many Ancient Starry Sky Deities who had lived for unknown eons were stuck at this level.

But what the nine Supreme Beings on the field did not know was that Lin Yuan had the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses’ insights into the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, reaching the Fifth Realm in this fusion rule was not difficult for him, and it wouldn’t even take much time, he could progress gradually.

Lin Yuan’s true target was the Space-Time Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm; only the Twelfth Rank Ultimate Realm would hold real significance for him.

“It seems you really don’t need to go to the ‘shore’ anymore.”

“But the Two-dimensional World was beneficial; what reward do you want?”

The Ancient Power Supreme Being asked.

The treasury of Human Civilization includes many treasures and rare items, some of which are of the Twelve-Star Level.

“I’ll leave it to the Supreme Beings to decide.”

Lin Yuan immediately responded.

He did not know what to choose, but as Ultimate beings, the Supreme Beings would surely not make a poor decision.

“We decide?”

The Ancient Power Supreme Being and the other eight Supreme Beings exchanged glances.

Lin Yuan knew that the nine Supreme Beings must have been communicating secretly among themselves.

A moment later.

Xia Qin Supreme Being spoke, his expression somewhat solemn: “Although you’re only at the Tenth Rank now, you should also consider the challenge to reach the Ultimate. This rare treasure should suit you.”

With a wave of his right hand, a hazy universe appeared before him, which then began to infinitely contract, transforming into a bead and flying towards Lin Yuan.

Whoosh!

As the bead slowly floated, Lin Yuan’s expression shifted slightly; he felt as if he were in front of a vast universe.

“Is this a Micro Star Universe? No, it’s more real than a Miniature Universe…” Among the many treasures and rare items Lin Yuan had seen, only the Miniature Universe closely resembled this bead.

But it was only similar; although the Miniature Universe had a complete set of space-time rules operating, it was ultimately inanimate, but this bead seemed to be alive.

“This rare treasure, called ‘Source of the Universe,’ can aid your Inner World in its metamorphosis into an Inner Universe.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being explained the use of the bead.

“Aid in metamorphosing the Inner World into an Inner Universe?” Lin Yuan took a deep breath.
